stories.title: Trump targets birthright citizenship. And, Iran aims to ban U.S. from Strait of Hormuz
stories.description: President Trump says he has signed two new orders targeting birthright citizenship. And, Iran is aiming to ban U.S. ships from the Strait of Hormuz.

stories.title: Cuba: No power, no fuel, no internet
